# #209 — Add TypeScript thin client memory wrapper

## Goal
Add a lightweight TypeScript wrapper equivalent in spirit to the Python adapter so local tools and Hermes-adjacent TypeScript callers can use Open Brain as a memory manager.

## Scope
- Typed wrapper around session_start, session_context, append_session_event, lane_upsert, search_all, brain_answer, session_wrap, and repo facts.
- Helper methods for adapter contract lifecycle calls.
- Retry/spool behavior or explicit deferral if not in this slice.
- Metadata safety checks, including protected authority keys and bounded metadata.
- Support metadata.okf and receipt metadata without forcing OKF storage.

## Acceptance Criteria
- TypeScript wrapper has focused fake-transport tests for call shape and error handling.
- Wrapper exposes lifecycle methods that map to the adapter contract.
- Public contract/version implications are documented.

## Timeline
Target date: 2026-06-27.
